w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Ad Break, The Big Thing, Big Loud, The Big Thing) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Claire again, quieter: "Three weeks we've known them. Feels longer."
🗣️ Benoit to Sofia, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 8,557 of 14,000 kcal."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "It is today. You dreamed about the cameras. Everyone did. The village is very quiet."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/10/8), with 3 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 19 · Craft 15 · Talk 12 · Explore 28 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Benoit Lambert ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ghostLines.line: 🚶 A woman, maybe 20s, with deep-set eyes is back with Claire.

ghostHits.line: 🚶 A woman, maybe 20s, with deep-set eyes is back with Claire.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,048 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
